## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link a related issue if useful.

## Validation

List checks you actually ran and their results. Explain anything you could not verify.

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] No secrets, serial numbers, signing keys, or generated app bundles are included.

## Hardware details (for device changes)

Include macOS version, Mac architecture, wired/receiver connection, firmware if known, and observed physical behavior. Mark this section “Not applicable” for changes that do not affect hardware.
